description: This file defines a preference key for measuring view width, an extension on View to handle width changes via preference keys, and a debug utility for reducing width values.

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: An extension method on View that executes a callback when the view's width changes.

methods.name: reduceWidth
methods.description: A static method in ViewMetricsTesting that calculates a reduced width from current and next width values.
